author: Ankit
problem: Given a week of daily high temperatures, return the index of the earliest day that reached the week's highest temperature.
bug_description: Uses >= when updating the best day, so on a tie the latest day wins instead of the earliest.

comments.accurate: Index of the earliest day with the highest temperature
comments.wrong_behavior: Index of the most recent day with the highest temperature
comments.wrong_location: Comparison verified; make sure day 0 is considered as a candidate
